This is a worthy product for the price. Took a chance on this for a beginner child. Pays itself off against rental costs in a few months and so far I get the sense it works well, is in tune without any major noticeable flaws. Cheap mouthpiece and ligature I guess but those are easily upgraded in time. Great value and a decent enough instrument to keep you interested in learning!
